name: STAR Numerics — Lagrange interpolation of tabulated data
summary: Value and first derivative of the interpolating polynomial through 2 to 20 tabulated points, in barycentric form; within 7e-15 of exact rational arithmetic on 600 tables, closer to the exact value than SciPy (1.2e-14) and NumPy (7e-11) on the same tables; extrapolation refused.
reference: Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, Example 3.a: Mars at 0.884226, 0.877366, 0.870531 AU on 1992 November 7, 8, 9 (0h TD) is at 0.876125 AU on November 8 at 4h 21m
reference_observed: 0.8761253: within 3e-7 of the printed value (printed to 1e-6)

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: the units are the caller's; nodes and values are parallel lists; the derivative is per unit of x
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; extrapolation refused; the difference between evaluation accuracy and interpolation accuracy stated
